visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Radio Buttons Share a Name
visualizerParams.description: Type three radio buttons that share one name. Radio buttons with the same name are a group, and only one of them can be chosen at a time.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<form>
  <label><input type="radio" name="size" id="s"> Small</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="size" id="m"> Medium</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="size" id="l"> Large</label>
</form>

checks.label: Only one button is chosen at the end
